title: Writing Weights or Training Them? Spatial Reasoning through Weight-Space Programming and Low-Rank Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27089v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight-space programming lets a language model inspect and edit another model's weights, offering an alternative to gradient-based adaptation. We evaluated both approaches using Qwen3.5-0.8B on a fixed reference-frame task (128 items), StepGame (200 items), and two untrained distance-comparison tasks. With thinking enabled, the public patch (p50c) raised mean accuracy from 0.0% to 22.1% on the reference-frame task and from 19.2% to 33.7% on StepGame across three sampling seeds. Randomly permuting its weight change removed the gain. Further closed-form edits did not improve on p50c, whereas a rank-1 LoRA adapter trained on worked solutions reached 100% and 98.8%, respectively, with 0.09% trainable parameters. Removing the worked solutions from supervision prevented the adapter from passing the learning gate. translated_title: 直接写入权重还是训练权重？基于权重空间编程与低秩自适应的空间推理
translated_abstract: 权重空间编程使一个语言模型能够检查并编辑另一个模型的权重，为基于梯度的自适应方法提供了一种替代方案。我们使用Qwen3.5-0.8B在固定参照系任务（128题）、StepGame（200题）以及两个未经训练的距离比较任务上对两种方法进行了评估。在开启思考模式的条件下，公开补丁在三个采样种子下将参照系任务的平均准确率从0.0%提升至22.1%，将StepGame的准确率从19.2%提升至33.7%。随机打乱其权重改变会消除这一增益。进一步的闭式编辑未能超越p50c，而基于解题示例训练的秩1 LoRA适配器在两个任务上分别达到了100%和98.8%的准确率，且可训练参数仅占0.09%。若从监督信号中移除解题示例，适配器则无法通过学习门槛。训练后的适配器在未见过的StepGame句子模板上达到82%的准确率，在训练后留出的6-10难度级别上达到42%的准确率。
tldr: 在空间推理任务上，权重空间编程带来的提升有限，而仅用0.09%可训练参数、以解题示例为监督训练的秩1 LoRA适配器可近乎完美地解决参照系与StepGame任务，并对未见模板和更高难度展现一定泛化能力。
en_tdlr: Weight-space programming yields only modest gains on spatial reasoning tasks, whereas a rank-1 LoRA adapter trained on worked solutions with just 0.09% trainable parameters achieves near-perfect performance and generalizes to unseen templates and higher difficulty levels.
